notes.title: Buddy Bug Dev Log#3
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Hello! Since our first playtest, we have developed clearer plans for improving the dual-player mode experience, optimizing controls, and developing new content. In this dev log, we will detail these plans and welcome your suggestions. 
(The information below is version that under development.)
________________________________________
[h2]I. Co-op Mode[/h2]
Through this playtest and offline demo events, many players invited friends to experience the game. We received numerous suggestions for the co-op mode, such as adding dual-player combo skills, enriching item interaction combinations, and introducing mutual sabotage/combat modes.
First, we will definitely enrich item interaction combinations in the future. Whether in single-player or co-op modes, item interactions remain the core gameplay. In co-op mode, as two players can choose different weapons, weapon-item interactions will become even more diverse.
Example:
• Player A selects Pile Driver
• Player B selects Lighter
• Players obtain an enchantable item like Tennis Ball
• After Player B ignites the ball, Player A uses the Pile Driver to repeatedly launch flaming tennis balls, dealing fire-attribute damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/110e9136fdc69c8eace02baa6578ed5f807353a4.gif[/img]
We will deepen weapon-item synergy mechanisms to ensure effective cooperation between any weapon combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/4ebf68899e5c4bd862c2ed9fccfe2b7f1eda11b2.gif[/img]
Mutual Sabotage/Combat
We are considering adding mutual sabotage/combat mechanics. These will undergo internal testing first, and if successful, be included in future player tests. Given the visually busy combat scenes, we need to ensure these mechanics don’t negatively impact the experience.
Current Concepts:
1. Special stages dedicated to chaotic PvP fun
2. NO friendly damages. You can push mates into a trap by"accident" !
Unlike split-screen modes in other games, our co-op uses shared-screen viewing. Current issues include:
• Camera confusion causing Player 2 to exit the frame
• Abrupt camera transitions during jumps
We are prioritizing fixes for camera shake and character disappearance before the next playtest.
Combo Skill Development
We are testing dual-player combo mechanics to expand cooperative depth.
________________________________________
[h2]II. Hardware & UI Optimization[/h2]

[h3]1. Control Schemes[/h3]
• Expanded customizable key bindings (fixed key binding save errors from last test)
• Controller improvements:
- Remapped B button to "Cancel"
- Optimized item switching shortcuts
- Fixed controller priority being lower than keyboard/mouse

[h3]2. UI Interactions[/h3]
• Streamlined redundant on-screen information
• Redesigned UI (currently testing):
- Relocated cooldown timers from bottom-left to prominent positions
- Enhanced visual cues for in-game buffs
- Removed intrusive item description popups during combat
- Smoother NPC interactions (no strict proximity requirement)
This UI overhaul will undergo iterative improvements through future playtests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/f0262d02c656b78b542c2ff77b43ac170c448027.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Device Support[/h3]
• Steam Deck: Adaptation largely complete (optimizing font scaling & performance)
• Future cross-platform plans remain secondary to PC version prioritization.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/9c94bb7c32b56fb76260513b001f0205ba75078d.jpg[/img]
________________________________________
[h2]III. New Content[/h2]
[h3]1. Weapon & Item Reworks[/h3]
[b]Conceptual Designs:[/b]
•Defensive shield for bashing
•Water-spewing syringe as a spear
Player Suggestions Being Reviewed:
• Key-shaped swords
• Retractable boxcutter spears

[b]Elemental Reaction System:[/b]
Current issues with inconsistent elemental combinations (e.g., water + oil failing to react) are being addressed through:
• Item Modification System: Lets players permanently add elemental attributes to any item.


[h3]2. Terrain Interactions[/h3]
Focusing on mechanic-driven environmental interactions:
• Freezer Stage Example:
- Water freezes into movable ice blocks (block enemies or knock them back)
- Dripping water forms attackable ice spikes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/ca755cff09e5f51b2ed020d74bbbade8c6657cae.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Food Defense Mode[/h3]
A tower defense-inspired standalone stage:
• Objective: Protect giant leftover food from enemy insects

• Mechanics:
- Enemies prioritize stealing food over attacking
- Deploy traps or attack directly
- Co-op role division supported
• Rewards: Scale with remaining food quantity

notes.title: Buddy Bug Dev Log#2
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Following our previous discussion on core gameplay iteration ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3374020/view/550109885443867975?l=schinese]check Devlog #1 here[/url]), we're excited to share updates on art and narrative redesigns.

[h2]I. Visual Overhaul[/h2]

[h3]1.Character Illustrations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/81c9653f15e644771f3d592354b58b5404930ff2.png[/img]
We're redesigning the controversial monster visuals. The current black ant designs lack distinctive insectoid features and appear overly generic. Our solution: Replacing them with red imported fire ant

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/a598a852b38ae112dcd8d1f80a5cf591105eb9fc.png[/img]
The "Bell Bug"
While its bell-shaped head creates visual interest, players reported confusion about its insect type and attack logic. Clarification: This is a cockroach-type unit with non-combat capabilities. Its core mechanic—summoning multiple roachlings—is inspired by cockroaches' rapid reproductive cycle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/8e5600617d3b7ac650b5015e059c5a29daa59297.png[/img]
Cockroach-Type Enemies
To balance realism and stylization: 
1.Key anatomical features (antennae, wings, segmented limbs) will be emphasized. 
2.We will also maintain cartoonish proportions to avoid uncanny valley effects
3. Color palettes will differentiate summoner/caste variants.

[h3]2. Level Design Optimization[/h3]
Player feedback during Playtests highlighted issues with overly monotonous visuals in combat zones and hub areas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/4c7eb571214f61c42781aa7cc5c702b743683e86.png[/img]
Chapter 1's setting intentionally depicts Buddy battling through cockroach-infested garbage piles stacked with delivery boxes. This "Cardboard Citadel" draws inspiration from Kowloon Walled City's claustrophobic architecture, creating:
• Oppressive environments with sunlight blocked by towering containers
• Air thick with smoke and particulate matter
• Visual motivation for Buddy's quest to reach open spaces
However, balancing this aesthetic with gameplay needs proves challenging:
• Brightening foreground combat areas risks visual chaos during co-op play
• Excessive particle effects may obscure interactive elements
• Platform legibility issues persist (players struggle to distinguish navigable surfaces)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/27e46b6ba2d8cb22f50db7861d19257cc55a5ef6.png[/img]
We will implement a three-layer visual overhaul (background, midground, foreground combat zones) to enhance immersion:
• Foreground combat areas will retain muted tones to avoid visual interference
• Background layers will feature richer details showcasing human traces, like our upcoming supermarket map:
• Colorful snack packaging
• Swinging price tags
• Falling promotional flyers
We’ve also identified platform design flaws in focal layers:
• Players struggle to distinguish standable platforms from drop-through platforms
• Planned optimizations include adjusting brightness/contrast to clarify actionable areas
These improvements will be showcased in new map gameplay videos scheduled for release in June.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/6339dc428d71c20d0625f05424a83eaa5fd888d3.png[/img]

To address the low visibility of external development zones in the home area—where players often miss functional sections while passing by—we will optimize the scene's circulation paths:
[b]• Lighting adjustments: [/b]Reduce overall brightness in the home area
[b]• Streamlined structures:[/b] Remove temporarily unused "distracting buildings"
[b]• Functional room entrances:[/b] Enhance doorframe visibility through dynamic lighting and UI highlights
We're transitioning functional zones to an open-plan layout, eliminating immersion-breaking gate interactions. Players will now seamlessly enter rooms without needing to press F at doorways.
These pathing improvements, paired with the revamped tutorial, will intuitively guide players through all key functional spaces.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/1c728c695288a7f8f2ed44623b4903288a166ee5.png[/img]

[h3]3. Insect Behavior Feedback[/h3]
In player surveys, some suggested adding beetle-characteristic behaviors to characters, NPCs, and enemies. These could manifest as idle animations (e.g., wing vibrations) or combat actions like horn charges.
We've drafted preliminary plans, but implementation requires coordination across:
• Animation sets
• Combat VFX
• Stat balancing
• Significant development resources
The final design remains under team discussion due to these complex dependencies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/bfea9a6345bf757ae3b72e2192b9af582f415a49.jpg[/img]

[b]Take our in-development "Mosquito Monster" as an example:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/152c15c48b0bf40551ddc790a8b1b8b837e1691b.gif[/img]
When receiving a powerful knockback:
1. Eyeballs dramatically bulge and protrude
2. Body curls into a ball mid-air trajectory
3. Impact leaves it prone on the ground with:
· Twitching limbs/wings
· Erratic eyeball rotations

Recovery sequence:
1. Limbs tremble while lifting torso
2. Eyeballs reset with head-shaking motion
3. Wings flutter for vertical recovery
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/668aceb94dc402722ab403a6bfc7c2ff2506b04e.png[/img]

[b]Another Example: "Pill Bug"[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/b750d5589256d50e5a7200e4e3a36457504fd606.gif[/img]
As shown in the attached image, this creature's defining trait is curling into a spherical form to achieve both offensive and defensive effects.
During powerful knockbacks:
1. Contraction: Instantly forms a perfect sphere
2. Impact: Collides with the ground, bouncing slightly before landing prone
3. Recovery:
· Pushes off the ground with both hands
· Executes a small hop to regain upright posture
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/e0173567b60febee50d7408c987eafad7843197e.png[/img]
[b]Impact on Game Feel[/b]
These VFX feedback mechanisms significantly influence control feel—a complex concept we're optimizing across multiple dimensions.
Please note:
• [b]Current implementations remain in design/whitebox testing phases[/b]
• Final effects may differ substantially
• Player suggestions for improvement are actively welcomed


Narrative Framework
Buddy Bug's core narrative can be summarized as: "An insect's journey of growth, adventure, and self-discovery."
Protagonist Profile
Buddy, a scarab beetle dwelling in the slums of Buggle Town, embodies the struggles of small-town youth yearning to break free from oppression by the Black Force Gang. The catalyst occurs when:
•A weaponsmith mentors him in combat mechanics
•His first successful foraging mission retrieves a block of cheese
•This sparks realization: Proactive exploration trumps scavenging garbage like his peers
Narrative Implementation
In our initial playtest build, we prioritized core gameplay over story integration. Future development will emphasize:
1. Mandatory Story Beats
• Key character development moments
• Gang conflict escalation sequences

2. Environmental Storytelling
• NPC relationship trees revealed through dialog choices
• Worldbuilding via interactable objects (e.g., decaying gang notices, abandoned larva toys)

3. Collection Unlock System
• Collectible bestiary entries detailing faction histories
• Achievement-triggered flashback cutscenes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/0b2cf2530ee08e466c74eaf5bd07dff456ef8efd.png[/img]

The current NPCs in the home area (Buggle Town) are anthropomorphic in design, with most only providing storyline and basic daily dialogue.In future updates, we plan to design insect-themed idle animations and sound effects.As gameplay systems expand, some NPCs will gain specific functional attributes.

We will continue sharing development progress videos through our official channels! Stay tuned;)


Buddy Bug Team
April 2025

notes.title: Buddy Bug Dev Log#1
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you sincerely for participating in the Buddy Bug Playtest from February to March and providing invaluable feedback! Based on questionnaire data and open suggestions, we have finalized a comprehensive optimization plan for the core systems. 

[h3]I. Combat Experience Optimization[/h3]

[b]1. Enhanced Control Feel[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/784e2a38e8c0504ab38a7d36ad0b17c1362561c9.gif[/img]
Based on player feedback from the questionnaires,  we will optimize these systems. Certain weapons, particularly the Pile Driver, exhibit slight displacement during attacks, with complex directional inputs (up, down, left, right, and four diagonal directions).

After internal discussions, we are considering either temporarily removing the Pile Driver or redesigning it as a terrain-collision tool focused on forceful knockback. 
Also, we will rework the charging mechanics, balance damage output with operational complexity, and reduce the monotony of "stationary attacks."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/eb64bb8ac8b742721ca3757c7e253d44d10eb62b.gif[/img]
For weapons like the Lighter, the primary build directions are "stationary DPS" (charged bursts) and "dynamic mobility" (using recoil for aerial movement).Both directions will be enhanced by adding advanced modifiers to differentiate their experiences.Future updates will directly boost the Lighter’s base attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/e3b86a88f52ffc3b9666bd587ceee1c887df0f30.gif[/img]
Additionally, players reported issues with prop overload and ineffective interactions. We will overhaul prop mechanics to improve controllability. For example: The Spring will become active-triggered, requiring players to initiate a jump or other action to activate it, avoiding unintended launches upon contact.
Props will deploy instantly at the player’s location, eliminating directional/distance adjustments.
Props will attack immediately after deployment, without waiting for enemies to approach.
New dash-attack mechanics will ensure compatibility between all weapons and props, resolving issues where elemental weapons fail to trigger certain physical prop effects.

Finally, we will optimize UI indicators for prop cooldowns and streamline controller quick-access controls.

[b]2. Expanded Weapon-Prop Synergy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/f0ec16e782ccbdddf4828714f8eb588552c34d7d.gif[/img]
The synergy between weapons and props is a core combat mechanic in our game. We’ve designed diverse combinations, such as:
- Using the Lighter and Grease projectile props to ignite enemies.
- Use an electromagnetic gun to conduct electricity through water stains.

While most players find the weapon-prop synergy engaging, feedback highlights insufficient depth in current combinations. Future updates will introduce new Elemental Reactions to break existing build limitations. Concept is still in development, and we welcome further suggestions!

[h3]II. Level Design Improvements[/h3]

[b]1. New Player Guidance Overhaul[/b]
Some players in this test reported missing basic tutorials, such as gliding mechanics and acquiring new weapons. We’re exploring ways to integrate these guides seamlessly—for example, embedding basic controls into mini transition stages, where players advance by performing correct actions, gradually mastering mechanics. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/d55600453357f8be1783e69e6a468905dbfabc3b.gif[/img]

[b]2.Map Interaction & Exploration[/b]
As a side-scroller, our camera perspective is less flexible than top-down or 3D games. Observing player tests offline, we noticed flaws in the flow paths of the home area (e.g., players missing key functional zones in left-to-right scenes). Future updates will refine the home area’s linear layout alongside the new guidance system. 

[h3]III. Enemy Design & Challenge Tuning[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/1a2af7c085d67d9869d777578157e4840a62b091.gif[/img]
Currently, enemy types are categorized into standard enemies, elites, and bosses, with attack patterns including homing bombs, ranged bullets, poison gas bombs, bat swings, and charges. 

Elemental resistances will be tested in future versions. Instead of requiring specific elements to break defenses, resistant enemies will take reduced damage from their countered element and increased damage from opposing elements. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/0cb976b05bc22317dbddf8ee02fb6a4b69578f1c.gif[/img]
We’ve also heard casual co-op players requesting a more relaxed, stress-free experience in cooperative modes. 

[h3]III. Progression System Refinements[/h3]

[b]1. In-Mission Rewards & Positive Feedback[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/b17d162cd8defb2e99e0aa03754449826001fd13.png[/img]
In the current playtest build, numerical values are intentionally unstable to test overall stage playability, and we’ve temporarily reduced in-mission reward distribution. Once content and stage structures are finalized, we’ll optimize this further. 

[b]2. Out-of-Mission Progression & Build Diversity[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484901/e5b33e9c886024515748fae8dba44a648b6253bc.png[/img]
The game’s meta-progression includes universal talents and character-specific talents, with stats and abilities tied to in-mission knowledge and weaponry. Once in-mission content is solidified, we’ll expand out-of-mission systems and design unique abilities based on each insect character’s biological traits. 

As we unveil our inaugural developer log, we’d like to introduce the passionate minds behind Buddy Bug.
Since we founded our studio in 2017, we believe that making games and farming have a lot in common: sowing the seeds of creativity, watering them with passion, and patiently waiting for the flowers to bloom. Now the team has grown to twenty people. From Eastern Exorcist to Buddy Bug, we have always bent over like planting rice seedlings. Some ask: Why is the style of this game so different from the previous one?
 
Both Eastern Exorcist 2 and Buddy Bug are currently in development. Our intention in creating 'Buddy Bug' was to try another way to tell a Chinese-style story that players from all over the world can also immerse themselves in. Supermarket shelves resembling skyscrapers, paper walled cities piled up like mountains, we transform into a small insect and experience the wonders of these microscopic worlds, just like when we were a child squatting on the ground observing ants moving. That pure curiosity is the most authentic joy of games. And silly Buddy always reminds us of our past selves – who leaving home alone for thousands of miles and earn a living in the city.

We expect to complete the adjustment and optimization of weapons and props, as well as guidance, in the version by the end of May. At that time, we wound like to show some clips in communities. Thank you once again for playing our game! We will continue to interact with you in the community and synchronize our development plans and progress.

[h3]Buddy Bug Team[/h3]

notes.title: You can send a Playtest request now!
notes.content:
When?
Spots will be granted starting early March.

How to Apply:
Visit Buddy Bug's Steam store page and click the "Request Access" button - it's that easy! Selected participants will be chosen via Steam's random selection process and notified via email. Keep an eye on your inbox!

Test Content:
Experience the game's first chapter featuring:
- Plenty of combinations of 4 weapon types and 25 items
- Local co-op support for two players

Want deeper insights into the game? Join our [url= https://discord.gg/CH9FpPnH6K]Discord community[/url] for exclusive updates and discussions!
